verses.text: Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha wal t'a jun pekti' ol jawok chi', a in ol in och sDiosalok junjun makanhil heb' yinhtilal Israel, haxo heb' ol och in chonhab'ok.
Ha heb' israel ix elkan t'a yol sk'ab' chamel, ix scha in wach'k'olal heb' t'a tzinan lu'um, ayik wan sayanek' heb' b'aj syik' yip.
Ha t'a pekataxo in ch'oxnak in b'a t'ayex walannak icha tik: Ex israel xajan ex wuj t'a masanil k 'inal, yuj chi' tz'ok'nhej in k'o'ol t'ayex.
Ol ex wik'xik'echa'anh. Eyet'nak he pandereta ol ex k'ex cheneljok yuj tzalajk'olal.
Ol eyawejxi te' eyuwa t'a lum tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Samaria. Ha mach ol yawej yuwa chi', ol yak' tzalajb'ok sk'ol yet' sat.

Yujto ol jawok jun k'uhal to a heb' stanhwumal chonhab' t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol smakb'en Efraín, cha'anh ol el yaw heb' icha tik: Kotanhek, koyek t'a Sion t'a Jehová ko Diosal, xcham heb', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: B'itananhek t'a tzalajk'olal yuj jun chonhab'il heb' yinhtilal Jacob, haton jun te niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh masanil nación. Ab'chajokab' he b'itani, tzeyalan icha tik: Mamin Jehová, kol onh a chonhab' onh tik, a onh ayonh to kan tik, xe chi.

Ol wik' meltzaj heb' t'a jun nación ay t'a norte. Ol in molb'ejkot heb' b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal. Ha t'a skal heb' chi', hata' ol jawok heb' max yal-laj yilani yet' heb' tz'em sb'eyi, heb' ix yab'ix yet' heb' ix hato wal yalji yune'. Te niwan ol aj sb'isul heb' smeltzajxi.

Haxonhej lesal yet' ok'el ol yak' heb' ayik ol meltzajxok heb'. Ha inxo ol wik'b'at heb' t'a ha ha' tz'el yok yet' t'a yol jun b'e te ak'lik, manhxa b'aj ol telwok heb'. Yujto mamab'il waj t'a chonhab' Israel tik. Haxo chonhab' Efraín, ichato in b'ab'el unin yaji, xchi Jehová.

Syalanxi Jehová chi' icha tik: Ex junjun nación, ab'ek wal in loloni. Alekel t'a juntzanh chonhab' lak'an yet' t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a sk'axepal ha' mar te najat ay, tzeyalan icha tik: Ha Jehová ix ak'an saklem heb' israel, hanhejtona' pax ol molb'anxikot heb'. Ol tanhwajxok heb' yuj icha tz'aj stanhwaj nok' kalnel yuj stanhwumal, xe chi.
Yujto ol in kolkanel heb' yinhtilal Jacob, ol in kolankan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanh nación te ay yip.

Ol ja heb', ol sb'itan b'it heb' t'a tzalajk'olal t'a tzalan Sion, haxo yak'an tzalajb'ok sk'ol heb' yet' jantak tas wach' ol wak' t'ay, haton ixim trigo, wino, aceite, nok' kalnel yet' nok' wakax. Lajan ol aj heb' icha te' awb'en te' aynhejoch yalil, manhxo ol el-laj yip heb' junelxo.

Ol k'e cheneljok heb' ix kob'estak yuj tzalajk'olal. Ol tzalaj pax heb' winh kelemtak yet' heb' winh ichamtak winak. Ha in ol wak' sniwanil sk'ol heb', ol meltzajoch skusk'olal heb' t'a tzalajk'olal, yelxo niwan stzalajk'olal heb' ol wak' t'a yichanh yahelal ix yil heb'.
Ha heb' sacerdote a wal wa'el te wach' ol wak' swa heb', haxo heb' in chonhab' ol yak' tzalajb'ok sk'ol yet' masanil tas ol wak' t'ay, xchi Jehová.

Syalanxi Jehová chi' icha tik: Tz'ab'chaj wal yoch aw t'a chonhab' Ramá, ay mach sik'sik'an wal yok' yuj yahelal. Ha ix Raquel tz'ok' wal ix yuj heb' yune'. Manhxa snib'ej ix sniwanaj sk'o'ol, yujto manhxalaj heb' yune' ix ix kani.

Ach Raquel, manhxo ach ok'ok, mokxob' el yal a sat yujto a in Jehová in swala', a tas ix a k'ulej yuj swach'ilok heb' une' chi', ol a cha spak. Ha heb' une' chi', ol elta heb' t'a schonhab' heb' ajk'o'ol, ol jaxkan kajan heb' t'a tik.
Ha in Jehová in swala' to syal ak'anoch yipok a k'ol tas ol ujok t'a b'ak'inh. Ha heb' une', ol meltzajxok heb' t'a schonhab' tik.

Ix wab' wal sk'akwi heb' aj Efraín yuj kusk'olal, syalan heb' icha tik: Ix onh a k'ayb'ej icha tz'aj sk'ayb'aj junok nok' kelem wakax manh yojtakok smunlaji, palta ix kileli. Ik'onh meltzaj het'ok, b'ekan ko k'ol ko meltzaji, yujto a ach tik Jehová, ko Diosal ach.

Ix kik'el ko b'a t'ayach, palta ix ko na ko b'a tikne'ik. Ayik ix nachajel ko chukal ku'uj, toxonhej ix onh em nhojan yuj k'ixwelal. Emnakilxonhej skutej ko b'a yuj jantak ko mul ix och t'a yiktax ko kelem uninal, xchi heb' aj Efraín chi' t'ayin.

Ha in Jehová in swala' to a heb' aj Efraín tik, ichato wuninal yaj heb', xajan heb' wu'uj. Wach'chom swak' syahelal heb', palta max waktej in na'an heb', ya swab' yuj heb', yujto tz'ok' wal in k'ol t'a heb'.

Ex aj Israel, sik'lab'il tzeyilkan jun b'e b'aj tzex b'ati, yujto hanheja' t'a jun b'e chi' ol ex meltzajxok yik tzex jax t'a he chonhab' ol eyaktejkan tik. Meltzajanhek ex chonhab' Israel. Meltzajanhek t'a juntzanh he chonhab'.

¿B'ak'inh ol eyaktejkan he b'eyek' icha junok ix ix te pit? Ha in Jehová in ol wak' ujok junok tas to manta b'aj tzuji t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik: Ha junok ix ix ol tzuntzanb'at junok winh winak, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, haton ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a tz'alan icha tik: Ayik ol wik'anxikot heb' israel tik t'a slu'um b'aj kajantaxoni, ol laj yal heb' anima kajan t'a yol yik Judá icha tik: Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a yib'anh jun tzalan sik'b'ilel yuj, b'aj sb'eyb'alaj tojolal, xcham heb'.
Ol laj kajnajxok heb' anima t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá yet' heb' munlajwum tz'awan tastak, yet' pax heb' tanhwum kalnel ol kajnaj heb' ta'.
Ha in ol wak'xi yip heb' k'unb'inak. Ha heb' tz'el yip yuj wejel, ol wak' b'ut'jok sk'ol heb', xchi Jehová.
Ayik ix lajwi wilan juntzanh tik ix el in wayanh, ix in ek' k'elelok, te wach' jun ix ch'oxji wil tik.
Ha wal Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ol k'och sk'uhal, ol wak'anxi k'ib' sb'isul heb' anima yet' nok' nok' t'a Israel yet' t'a Judá.

Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to icha wal ix aj wak'an wip in tok'aneli, in juanemi, wak'an ik'jokemi, in sataneli yet' wak'an ixtajok, hanhejtona' icha chi' ol aj wak'anxi wip wak'anxiem yich, yik tzin b'oanxik'ei.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' manhxo ol yal heb' anima icha tik: Ha heb' mamab'il ix slo te' uwa heb' te paj, haxo heb' uninab'il, jululixonhej sb'at spajil te' t'a yichtak ye heb', manh xchiok heb'.
Yujto junjun mach ol cham yuj smul. Ha mach ol loan te' paj uwa chi', munil a ol ab'an spajil te', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ol jawok sk'uhal, ol in b'oan junokxo in trato yet' heb' yinhtilal Israel yet' heb' yinhtilal Judá.

Ha in Jehová in swala' to a jun trato chi', manh lajanok yet' jun in b'onak yet' heb' he mam eyicham ayik wik'annakelta heb' t'a Egipto. Ichato ochnak in ketzketz t'a sk'ab' heb' ayik wik'annakelta heb' chi', palta maj sk'anab'ajej in trato heb' in b'o yet'ok, wach'chom ichato wetb'eyum wutejnak heb'.

Haton in trato tik ol in b'o heyet'ok a ex yinhtilal ex israel tik t'a jun pekti' chi': Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to ol wak'och juntzanh in cheknab'il t'a he pixan, ichato ol in tz'ib'ejkanoch t'a he pensar, ol in och he Diosalok, a exxo ol ex och in chonhab'ok.

Manhxo yowalilok ay junok ex ol eyal t'a heb' eyetchonhab' icha tik: Ojtakejel Jehová, manhxo xe chiok. Yujto a in Jehová in swala' to he masanil ol in eyojtakejeli, wach'chom heb' unin, ma heb' icham anima. Ol wak' niwank'olal schukal heb', manhxa b'ak'inh ol in nakot smul heb', xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová ix ak'ankanoch k'u yik syak'an sakil k'inal t'a k'uhalil, k'e'en uj yet' k'e'en k'anal yik syak' sakil k'inal t'ak'walil. A' tz'ak'ank'e ponhnaj ha' mar ayik sk'anh ha'. Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik:
Yakb'an manto satel juntzanh tz'ak'an sakil k'inal chi', a ex israel ex tik manh ol ex satel-laj t'a nacional t'a wichanh.

Ha in Jehová in swala': Icha satcha'anh malaj b'ak'inh syal yechtaji, mato icha sjulal yich lum lum malaj b'ak'inh tz'ojtakajeli, icha chi' waj eyet' in chonhab' israel ex tik, malaj b'ak'inh ol ex in patikejel yuj tas tze k'ulej, xchi Jehová.
Ha in Jehová in swalxi icha tik: Ol ja sk'uhal to ol b'ochajxik'e in chonhab', schael yich t'a torre Hananel, masanto ol k'och t'a jun puerta ay t'a jun schikin.
Tojolnhej ol b'at t'a smojonal, masanto t'a lum tzalan yik Gareb, skumlajb'at t'a stojolal Goa.

Masanil lum sch'olanil b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak, b'aj sb'at yumchajkanel k'e'en tik'ak'il ta'anh yet' t'a yib'anh sti' ha ha' skuch Cedrón, masanto t'a junxo schikin b'aj ay puerta yik nok' chej, t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, wik ol ajkanok. Masanil juntzanh chi', manhxa b'ak'inh ol juchajemok, manhxa b'ak'inh ol satelok, xchi Jehová.
